protocol.disclosure: This is a theory-registered posthoc iteration after earlier benchmark scores had already been opened. Formal retained results, preregistered development failures, and component diagnostics are reported separately.

spin9_local9.method: exact reference adjoint plus release-compatible query-conditioned diffusion v1

reproduced_reference.information_condition: full reference mask plus online SAM processing of every registered RGB, including target RGB; target masks are not used during generation

nvos_strict_source_only_full8.information_condition_warning: The compatible result performs online target-view RGB SAM calls and uplifts one query-specific scalar mask field.

implemented_contract: explicit continuous unary y_i and confidence c_i
query gate g_i applied to pairwise conductance
symmetric degree normalization recomputed after gating
exact positive and negative hard constraints
legacy solver defaults and cached affinity behavior preserved

continuous_convex_v2.mechanism: Hard reference locks improve the reference view but create a shifted high-score domain and do not supply the missing target-view object evidence; reference gain and target delta are strongly anticorrelated.

sam_query_interface_component.scope: posthoc attribution only, not a formal local9 replacement
sam_query_interface_component.lego: no exact persisted SAM rows align to the current carrier; faithful testing requires rerunning SAM and uplifting onto that carrier
sam_query_interface_component.conclusion: The remaining SPIn gap is primarily a strong transductive target-RGB SAM query-interface and cross-view completion gap, not evidence that another graph or a higher-dimensional relation field alone will close it.

mechanism: The exact 4096D diagonal LDA unary saturates at confidence above 0.99 and overfits the sparse scribbles.
With the unary fixed, k16 continuous smoothing over-selects weak near-boundary support and is not a drop-in replacement for the released K201 operator.

published_compatible_asset_audit.finding: The reproduced 0.91257685 path is an online target-RGB SAM query interface followed by a one-dimensional scalar uplift, not a query-free DINOv2 or PCA40 field.

lerf3d.candidate: one global scene-disjoint SurfaceRegion readout trained on the released VALA streaming cosine-tangent semantic target
lerf3d.mechanism: The robust central direction improves fixed-threshold calibration and selected purity, but suppresses minority view directions and makes related-instance pixel ranking less separable. Robust aggregation alone does not implement VALA marginal-contribution visibility lifting.

next_priority: Implement and label a published-compatible target-RGB SAM query interface for SPIn and NVOS; never report it as strict unseen.
For strict NVOS, improve signed source-only unary construction or source-to-target correspondence before changing the graph solver.
For LERF3D, add exact marginal-contribution visibility lifting and an objective that preserves per-view/hard-negative directional separation; robust aggregation alone is insufficient.

thermal.policy: 180-second telemetry, 83C launch inhibit, no soft pause, 87C hard abort only after two consecutive polls
